description: Empirical ethanol-yield lookup per feedstock (L EtOH / tonne feed) x fermentation-temperature multiplier (np.interp, peak near 32 C). Numbers derived from EC148 F1b sugar composition + yeast efficiency.
source: Chandel et al. (2011); Gay-Lussac stoichiometry; S. cerevisiae yeast data — reused from EC148 F1b

feedstock_table.comment: Ethanol yield (L EtOH / tonne feed) at optimum, reflecting sugar/starch/cellulose content & pretreatment efficiency from EC148 F1b.

temperature_curve.comment: Yield multiplier vs fermentation temperature (degC). Peak 1.0 at 32 C; yeast inhibited at low/high T.
